name: account-sale
title: Account sale
for_each: select a.id, a.number || ' ' || c.name as name from account_sales a join clients c on c.id = a.vendor_id join sales s on s.id = a.sale_id where s.sale_date >= agency_today() - 21 order by a.number

sections.title: Account sale
sections.sql: select a.number as "account sale", st.business_name as "agent", st.agency_code as "agent code", c.name as "vendor", coalesce(c.tax_no, '') as "ABN", coalesce(p.pic, '') as "PIC", s.name as "sale", s.sale_date as "sale date", coalesce(s.saleyard, 'private sale') as "saleyard", a.head, a.due_on as "settlement day", coalesce(a.paid_on::text, 'not paid yet') as "paid" from account_sales a join clients c on c.id = a.vendor_id join sales s on s.id = a.sale_id cross join settings st left join lateral (select pic from properties where client_id = c.id order by created_at limit 1) p on true where a.id = $1

sections.title: Your stock
sections.sql: select l.lot_no as lot, l.head, l.category, coalesce(l.avg_kg::text, '') as "avg kg", case when l.basis = 'kg' then round(l.price_cents, 1) || 'c/kg' else '$' || round(l.price_cents / 100.0, 2) || '/hd' end as price, round(l.per_head_cents / 100, 2) as "$/head", l.buyer, round(l.gross_cents / 100.0, 2) as gross from v_lots l join account_sales a on a.sale_id = l.sale_id and a.vendor_id = l.vendor_id where a.id = $1 and l.status = 'sold' order by (case when l.lot_no ~ '^[0-9]+$' then l.lot_no::int end), l.lot_no

sections.title: Charges
sections.note: Commission and yard dues carry GST. Transaction levies carry none and are paid to the government on our levy return.
sections.sql: select label as charge, sum(head)::int as head, round(sum(amount_cents) / 100.0, 2) as amount, round(sum(gst_cents) / 100.0, 2) as gst, round(sum(amount_cents + gst_cents) / 100.0, 2) as total from account_sale_lines where account_sale_id = $1 group by label, kind order by case kind when 'commission' then 0 when 'fee' then 1 else 2 end, label

sections.title: Proceeds
sections.sql: select round(gross_cents / 100.0, 2) as "gross", round(gst_cents / 100.0, 2) as "GST on stock", round(charges_cents / 100.0, 2) as "less charges", round(net_cents / 100.0, 2) as "net proceeds to you" from account_sales where id = $1

name: buyer-invoice
title: Tax invoice: livestock purchased
for_each: select i.id, i.number || ' ' || c.name as name from buyer_invoices i join clients c on c.id = i.buyer_id join sales s on s.id = i.sale_id where s.sale_date >= agency_today() - 21 order by i.number

sections.title: Invoice
sections.sql: select i.number as "invoice", st.business_name as "from", c.name as "to", coalesce(c.tax_no, '') as "ABN", s.name as "sale", s.sale_date as "sale date", i.head, i.due_on as "due", round(v.balance_cents / 100.0, 2) as "balance owing" from buyer_invoices i join clients c on c.id = i.buyer_id join sales s on s.id = i.sale_id join v_invoices v on v.id = i.id cross join settings st where i.id = $1

sections.title: Stock bought
sections.sql: select l.lot_no as lot, l.vendor, l.vendor_pic as "from PIC", coalesce(l.buyer_pic, '') as "to PIC", l.head, l.category, coalesce(l.avg_kg::text, '') as "avg kg", case when l.basis = 'kg' then round(l.price_cents, 1) || 'c/kg' else '$' || round(l.price_cents / 100.0, 2) || '/hd' end as price, round(l.gross_cents / 100.0, 2) as amount from v_lots l join buyer_invoices i on i.sale_id = l.sale_id and i.buyer_id = l.buyer_id where i.id = $1 and l.status = 'sold' order by (case when l.lot_no ~ '^[0-9]+$' then l.lot_no::int end), l.lot_no

sections.title: Total
sections.sql: select round(gross_cents / 100.0, 2) as "stock", round(gst_cents / 100.0, 2) as "GST", round(total_cents / 100.0, 2) as "total" from buyer_invoices where id = $1

name: market-report
title: Market report
for_each: select s.id, s.name from sales s where s.sale_date between agency_today() - 21 and agency_today() and exists (select 1 from lots l where l.sale_id = s.id and l.status = 'sold') order by s.sale_date

sections.title: The sale
sections.sql: select s.name as sale, s.sale_date as date, coalesce(s.saleyard, '') as saleyard, (select sum(head) from lots where sale_id = s.id and status = 'sold') as "head sold", (select count(*) from lots where sale_id = s.id and status = 'passed_in') as "lots passed in" from sales s where s.id = $1

sections.title: By category
sections.sql: select category, head, avg_kg as "avg kg", avg_c_per_kg as "avg c/kg", low_c_per_kg as "low c/kg", top_c_per_kg as "top c/kg", avg_dollars_per_head as "avg $/hd", top_dollars_per_head as "top $/hd" from v_market where sale_id = $1 order by head desc
